verdict.rationale: PostHog is a SaaS analytics platform with many AI features, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask, but nothing in the evidence describes a control, policy, or guarantee that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Self-hosting and the MCP server's region-scoped session storage are adjacent arrangements, not a documented training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
